mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, u.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age,
fp.annual_income, CAST(fp.income_type AS CHAR) AS income_type, CAST(fp.employment_status AS CHAR) AS employment_status, fp.credit_score, fp.liquid_asset_amount,
rp.residence_sido, rp.residence_sigungu, rp.residence_months, rp.employment_months, rp.has_income, rp.income_verifiable, rp.household_size, rp.marital_status, rp.has_children, rp.children_count, rp.basic_livelihood_recipient, rp.near_poverty, rp.single_parent_household, rp.disabled, rp.self_reliance_youth, rp.multicultural_household, rp.north_korean_defector, rp.child_headed_household, rp.earned_income_tax_credit_recipient, rp.basic_pension_recipient, rp.disability_benefit_recipient, rp.jeonse_fraud_victim, rp.household_annual_income, rp.household_net_asset_amount, rp.homeless_household, rp.household_head, rp.prospective_household_head, rp.first_time_home_buyer, rp.debt_default_status, rp.overdue_status, rp.policy_finance_usage, rp.financial_education_status, rp.desired_support_purpose, rp.desired_amount, rp.monthly_saving_capacity, rp.priority_preference
FROM app_user u
LEFT JOIN user_financial_profile fp ON fp.user_financial_profile_id = ( SELECT MAX(fp2.user_financial_profile_id) FROM user_financial_profile fp2 WHERE fp2.user_id = u.user_id )
LEFT JOIN policy_recommendation_profile rp ON rp.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
